_readme: Controller-owned. Only the gatekeeper (VS Code Claude session) writes verified fields, after observing the target environment directly (az containerapp show / live smoke probes) -- never from reading source, a merged PR, or an agent's claim. External agents may read this file and may propose an update in a PR, but the PR does not become truth until the gatekeeper re-observes and re-writes it. Use null / 'not_verified' rather than guessing; a wrong value here is worse than an honest gap.

staging.last_verification_method: az containerapp revision list (revision + image digest read off the live app), plus a live POST to /api/pilot/auth/magic-link/request (202) with the resulting container console line read back
known_staging_gaps: Outbound mail is refused by Exchange. Graph sendMail answers 403 with graph_error_code=ErrorAccessDenied for Admin@punxsyprominence.org, observed 2026-08-08T07:54Z. Not a permissions gap: a token probe run inside the container showed roles=["Mail.Send"] for appid 7835e2d0-4437-4845-8284-9ee147050296, and Test-ApplicationAccessPolicy reports Granted for Admin@ and Denied for three real staff mailboxes. Magic-link issuance therefore sends nothing. Redemption itself is verified working end to end (session cookie issued, replayed token refused, GET answered 405).

production.last_verification_method: az containerapp revision list (revision + digest read off the live app, byte-equal to the digest staging tested), single-revision mode with 100% traffic on latest confirmed; deploy-production's own 'Verify Production Schema Matches This Commit' and 'Pilot API Smoke Checks' steps both green in the run above
known_production_gaps: Magic-link mail delivery is not_verified on production. It has never been attempted here -- no production account has auth_provider='magic_link', so nothing would be sent. The Exchange refusal observed on staging is a tenant-level policy condition and should be assumed to apply to production until proven otherwise.

T-001, T-002 and T-003 reached production without a RUNTIME_VERIFIED row. Their PRs (#239, #242, #237) merged 2026-08-06 and rode to production inside this deploy of main. The pipeline's own rule is that no item may skip a state; this one was skipped, and is recorded here rather than backfilled.

known_applied_migrations: goal-category-progress (confirmed applied to both staging and production, apply-migrations runs 2026-08-05T03:48Z and 04:30Z)

magic-link (staging: apply-migrations run for 1adc244, 2026-08-08T05:31Z; production: run 31247060574, 2026-08-08T07:52Z, output 'PILOT MAGIC LINK MIGRATION PASS' against host ppbf-pg-195892.postgres.database.azure.com database postgres)
schema.note: This is a log of what has been OBSERVED applied via apply-migrations run output, not a generated schema version. Every pilot:apply-* runner is additive/idempotent, so re-running one is safe -- this list exists to avoid re-running unnecessarily, not to gate anything.

runtime_verified: magic-link redemption on staging: POST /api/pilot/auth/magic-link/consume returns 200 and sets ppbf_pilot_session for the correct principal; the same token replayed returns TOKEN_ALREADY_USED; GET returns 405 with Allow: POST so a mail scanner's prefetch cannot burn a link; exactly one session row created (2026-08-08, staging)
deployed_not_runtime_verified: T-002 covering-coach access window (#242, depends on #243)
magic-link issuance (the send half) -- deployed to both environments, blocked from verification by the Exchange refusal above
capabilities.note: Empty until the audit workflow's gap register is reconciled into intake/tickets/. Do not hand-populate this from source reading -- that is exactly the source-code-claims-mistaken-for-truth failure this file exists to prevent. The entries above are recorded from observed deploy runs and live probes, not from reading source.
